text.en:
lOth. NOVEMBER, 1984 No. S 37 THE EMERGENCY (EXTRADITION {MALAYSIA AND SINGAPORE))

ORDER, 1984 Notification under Section 1(2) In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 1(2) of the Emergency (Extradition [Malaysia and Singapore)) Order, 1984, His Majesty The Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan has been pleased to appoint 1st. November, 1984 as the date on which the said Order shall come into force in relation to the extradition of fugitive criminals to and from Malaysia. · Dated this 23rd. day of October, 1984.

BY COMMAND,

PENGIRAN BAHRIN (Pengiran Laila Kanun DirajaL Minister of Law Brunei Darussalam.
